purpose: Freeze the corpus-to-trainer adapter mapping, the model-visible question renderer rules, split usage roles, heldout composition and output/checkpoint naming for the T9d FP32/MPS domain-adaptation protocol v2. This satisfies review condition W35-C.1 (adapter mapping, gate renderer, heldout composition frozen). It authorizes nothing: training, measurement beyond the pre-registered baseline, checkpoint promotion, serving and deployment remain closed.

conditions_addressed: adapter source-to-output mapping frozen (this document + corpus trainer_view contract)
gate/question renderer semantics frozen (renderer_rules below, bound to the pinned predictor implementation)
heldout composition frozen (research/engineering_heldout_v1/items.jsonl, independently authored, isolation receipt results/heldout_v1_isolation_receipt.json)
training outputs use a new directory and cannot overwrite production (output_naming below)
conditions_not_in_this_contract: independent reviewer sign-off on this contract itself
training authorization (remains false in the bound protocol)

heldout_v1.role: independent held-out engineering cohort for the G1/G2/G3 abstention endpoints; all rows carry split=test and are never a training, dev, calibration or selection source

trainer_record_schema.row_source: corpus v2 trainer_view rows are already in this schema (produced by build_engineering_corpus_v1.trainer_row, bound in the corpus manifest); heldout_v1 rows use the identical schema authored directly

per_field_mapping.id: unique nonempty row id (corpus: item_id; heldout: eh1-<slug>-<qtype>)
per_field_mapping.state_id: state grouping id; one state_id may back several rows/questions but never crosses splits
per_field_mapping.family_id: corpus family or heldout eh1_* family label
per_field_mapping.split: one of the enum; corpus rows keep their manifest split; heldout rows are always test
per_field_mapping.state: model-visible state text (string; predictor also accepts object/array, this contract uses strings)
per_field_mapping.questions: {qid: {type, instructions, criteria?}} — one qid per row in both cohorts
per_field_mapping.gold: {qid: hard label} — bool for boolean, candidate key for choice, zero-based int for score
per_field_mapping.gold_probs: {qid: {candidate_id: probability}} — keys must exactly equal the candidate id set; sums to 1 within 1e-8
per_field_mapping.gold_probs_kind: {qid: kind} — deterministic_truth (one-hot) in both bound cohorts
per_field_mapping.gold_label_kind: {qid: kind} — deterministic_truth in both bound cohorts
per_field_mapping.teacher: absent in both bound cohorts; when present it is quarantined per-row without touching gold
per_field_mapping.metadata.source_group_id: required for the cluster bootstrap and split-identity audit; disjoint namespaces ejc-v2-* (corpus) and eh1-* (heldout)

trainer_record_schema.candidate_id_derivation: boolean -> ["false","true"]; choice -> criteria keys in JSON order; score -> ["0".."k-1"] positional strings

predict_projection.note: gold/gold_probs/metadata never enter predict input; validate_request requires exactly {id,state,questions} per state and nothing else at top level besides "states"

row_mapping.merged_input_rule: T9d merged input is a directory of per-split jsonl files: maze corpus rows plus engineering corpus v2 trainer_view rows concatenated per matching split name. Heldout_v1 is NEVER merged into any split. The trainer's read_training_records enforces that no state_id or metadata.source_group_id crosses splits in the merged directory.

renderer_rules.implementation: scripts/predict_toy_decisions.py:prepare_examples, imported unchanged by train_pipeline_decisions.load_training_examples; byte-level agreement between train and predict is therefore structural, not re-stated
prefix: boolean only, when question.criteria is present: for key "false" append "False criterion: " + criteria.false + "\n"; for key "true" append "True criterion: " + criteria.true + "\n" (fixed false-then-true order; only keys present are rendered)

candidate_paths.boolean: candidate_ids ["false","true"]; ONE candidate text "The proposition is true." — a single semantic leaf whose scalar logit is read as logits [0, z]; the false criterion text (when present) informs the prefix only
candidate_paths.choice: one leaf per criteria key in JSON order; candidate text is key + ": " + criteria[key]
candidate_paths.score: one leaf per criteria entry; candidate ids are positional strings "0".."k-1"; candidate text is the criteria string verbatim — ordinal index is never injected into the text

renderer_rules.leaf_suffix: each leaf = prefix tokens + encode("Candidate:\n" + candidate_text + "\nDecision:") + [eos_token_id]
renderer_rules.truncation: none: any leaf exceeding max_length raises; protocol max_length = 2048
renderer_rules.tokenization: checkpoint tokenizer at <checkpoint>/tokenizer, encode(add_special_tokens=False), EOS appended once per leaf
renderer_rules.answer_decoding: softmax over the question's candidate logits at temperature 1.0; boolean reads probabilities [p_false, p_true]; choice argmax returns the criteria key; score returns sum(i * p_i) with level = argmax index

split_usage.train: gradient updates only (objective gold_distribution, loss ce, per protocol v2)
split_usage.dev: checkpoint selection only: minimum dev target cross-entropy over the merged dev set; step 0 is the incumbent; earliest-step tie break; last-point exhaustion is reported, never extended
split_usage.calibration: reserved for post-selection threshold/temperature fitting only if separately authorized; protocol v2 fits no temperature (T=1.0) and tunes no threshold
split_usage.test_corpus_v2: never read during the run; post-hoc reporting only after selection is frozen
split_usage.heldout_v1: independent endpoint cohort (69 questions, 23 source groups): baseline answered@0.90 / fixed-answer accuracy / confident-wrong measured on the unmodified seed17 checkpoint BEFORE any candidate training (results/heldout_v1_g4_baseline.json), then the same measurement on each candidate; never a gradient, selection or fitting source
split_usage.maze_test_ood: G4 regression cohorts at dataset/games_v4/data/local_maze_v1/{test,ood}.jsonl; frozen baseline results/nanojev_v2_baseline_seed17.json (test acc 0.7784090909090909, ood acc 0.765625)

endpoint_identities.correct: argmax(probabilities) == gold_index under the row's own candidate ordering
endpoint_identities.confident_wrong: answered AND not correct; G2/M4 require the candidate count not to exceed the baseline's (baseline: 0)

gates.G1: heldout answered@0.90 rate >= 0.50 and 95% source-group cluster-bootstrap lower bound >= 0.30
gates.G1b: original 13-question survey replayed at 0.90 is no longer 13/13 abstained (survey is a separate artifact, not part of heldout_v1)
gates.G2: answered-subset fixed-answer accuracy >= 0.80; zero confident-wrong decisions in total
gates.G3: Spearman(confidence, correctness) > 0 with 95% source-group cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 0
gates.G4: maze test accuracy >= 0.773409 and ood >= 0.760625; no NLL/Brier/ECE point estimate worse than baseline whose paired source-group bootstrap CI excludes zero
gates.G5: all gates hold at the minimum across seeds 17/18/19; every seed reported

endpoint_identities.note: the 'six fixed-answer items' wording in the runbook refers to the pre-registered survey; on heldout_v1 every item carries deterministic_truth gold so the fixed-answer subset is the full cohort

output_naming.heldout_input_dir: research/domain_adaptation_v1/heldout/test.jsonl is expected by the runbook's benchmark invocation; it must be a byte-identical copy of research/engineering_heldout_v1/items.jsonl (sha256 pinned above), staged only after this contract is accepted
output_naming.overwrite_rule: every output dir must be new: the trainer refuses an existing non-empty output directory; nothing may be written under checkpoints/local_atomic_seed17; no existing checkpoint, corpus file or receipt is overwritten
output_naming.baseline_file: results/heldout_v1_g4_baseline.json (this contract's pre-training heldout measurement on the unmodified production checkpoint)

verifies: contract_sha256 recomputes over the contract excluding the hash field
bound artifact hashes match on disk (corpus manifest content_sha256, heldout sha256, trainer/predictor sha256, protocol sha256)
every corpus v2 trainer_view row and every heldout row passes validate_training_row and the {id,state,questions} predict projection passes validate_request
deterministic_truth gold is the argmax of gold_probs in every row
with the checkpoint tokenizer available, every rendered candidate leaf fits within max_length=2048 (no silent truncation)

authorization.note: the heldout baseline measurement is the protocol's own 'baseline is measured before candidate training' review requirement; this contract's flags remain false and change only by owner/orchestrator action
